content.comment_body: Hello all, I have a straightforward question related to [product_name] and digital flags. What is the memory address for digital flags M in [product_name]? I want to assign a digital tag as a field output in the [product_name] app. I assumed the digital flags M started at address 1104, with the first M1 at V1104.0, but within the app, I can't select that address—it only goes up to 850. My goal is to use a flag for a button status, to determine if a device is on or off. Hope this is clear. Thanks for your assistance. Regards.

You can use the M operand (flag) directly in the [product_name] app, without needing the VM area. VM memory simply mirrors the flag, enabling remote devices that don't recognize the M operand to access flags as well.
